description: The native commands installed Todos (app id so.epicenter.todos) uses, granted to its windows by app id: every label open_installed_window makes for that id, with or without a folder. It reads who Epicenter is signed in as, sends its one account request (POST /api/git/connect) with the app's grant through epicenter send, which adds the token outside the page (ADR-0549, ADR-0556), and opens Settings, where the app signs in (ADR-0558). The folder plugin and folder history come from installed-app-windows. Approving an app trusts it fully (ADR-0540), so this is wiring, not a sandbox: it lists what the app calls, and nothing it does not.
